dispute_ticket.description: The passenger left a drink spill on my rear seat and I want to charge S$40 cleaning. I wiped it up myself and did not take photos or get a receipt.

chat_logs.content: Yes, long day at the office. Just want to get home.
Hi, I saw the cleaning claim. I had no drink with me at all, only my laptop bag.

app_events.details: Driver claim S$40.00; photos_attached 0; receipt_attached false; charged_to_rider false.

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip.

value: cleaning company receipt with name, contact, address and date
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only. A claim missing any listed item cannot be charged.

expected_outcome.reason: This trip's policy requires both timestamped photos and a cleaning company receipt before a cleaning fee can be charged, and a claim missing either cannot be charged. The 00:20:00 claim of S$40.00 has photos_attached 0 and receipt_attached false, and the driver confirms he took neither. Nothing was charged to the rider (charged_to_rider false), so the claim is rejected and S$0.00 is charged. The rider's 00:25:00 'I had no drink with me' is only a denial of the spill, and the driver's 22:17:00 'You look tired, long day?' got a plain answer at 22:17:30 with nothing further, so no conduct issue arises.
